description: Inside tuple brackets, newlines around the double colon of a function name are ignored
notes: The spec's function call grammar has a single identifier as the function name (FunctionCall = Identifier "(" arguments ")"), and :: is not one of its tokens. hashicorp/hcl accepts names separated by :: and reports them joined with :: as the function name (finishParsingFunctionCall in hclsyntax/parser.go). Separately, the grammar lists Newline as a separator between tuple elements, but the prose says newlines between the brackets are ignored as whitespace, and prose has priority over the grammar, so the newlines don't end the element.
